entities.name: Birka & Christianisation of Sweden
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The trading town of Birka on Lake Mälaren, Ansgar's mission (829), the gradual Christianisation of Sweden — the last Scandinavian country to convert — the destruction of the pagan temple at Uppsala, and the rise of Sigtuna.
